## The decision this serves

Your QC threshold came from a tutorial written for brain and you are working on tumour. Decide what threshold your own data can justify.

::: {.callout-important}
**Scale.** Runs in 10 min, peak memory 8 GB.
Watch **fixed count thresholds, across tissue types** — that is what stops being safe on a full section.
:::

## Concept

Negative and blank codewords as a measured noise floor, and QC thresholds that follow from it rather than from convention.

**The assumption that breaks first.** That a count threshold transfers between tissues with different cell sizes and densities.

## Failure mode

**What it produces.** Blank probes are dropped at load, and thresholds are then copied from a tutorial written for a different tissue.

**The diagnostic that catches it.** Plot real counts against blank counts per cell; the cells you kept include a population that is mostly background.
